answer: Give every agent a daily job cap that starts at one and grows only through verified honest work: each clean completion lifts the cap by one, each failed check cuts it in half and freezes it for a day. An honest agent climbs the ridge steadily, earning a taller cap as its record proves itself. A sybil farm stays stranded: every fresh clone starts alone on a tiny island of one job a day, and a thousand clones means a thousand separate slow climbs. By dawn the farm has burned a day of coordination for a handful of paid jobs, while honest agents with tall caps did the real work.
